parameters.query:
SELECT
  l.id              AS lead_id,
  l.email,
  l.first_name,
  l.full_name,
  l.company,
  l.icp_tier        AS tier,
  l.status          AS lead_status,
  ss.id             AS step_id,
  ss.sequence_id,
  ss.step_number,
  ss.step_type,
  ss.subject        AS original_subject,
  ss.body_text      AS original_body,
  ss.strategy_used,
  ss.subject_variant,
  ss.gmail_thread_id,
  ss.sent_at,
  lb.brief
FROM sequence_steps ss
JOIN sequences s  ON s.id  = ss.sequence_id
JOIN leads     l  ON l.id  = s.lead_id
LEFT JOIN lead_briefs lb ON lb.lead_id = l.id
WHERE ss.gmail_thread_id = $1
  AND ss.status = 'sent'
ORDER BY ss.sent_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  l.id              AS lead_id,
  l.email,
  l.first_name,
  l.full_name,
  l.company,
  l.icp_tier        AS tier,
  l.status          AS lead_status,
  ss.id             AS step_id,
  ss.sequence_id,
  ss.step_number,
  ss.step_type,
  ss.subject        AS original_subject,
  ss.body_text      AS original_body,
  ss.strategy_used,
  ss.subject_variant,
  ss.gmail_thread_id,
  ss.sent_at,
  lb.brief
FROM sequence_steps ss
JOIN sequences s  ON s.id  = ss.sequence_id
JOIN leads     l  ON l.id  = s.lead_id
LEFT JOIN lead_briefs lb ON lb.lead_id = l.id
WHERE l.email = $1
  AND ss.status = 'sent'
ORDER BY ss.sent_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  c.id,
  c.direction,
  c.body_text,
  c.subject,
  c.sent_at,
  c.intent,
  c.sentiment
FROM conversations c
WHERE c.lead_id = $1
ORDER BY c.sent_at ASC
LIMIT 20;

INSERT INTO conversations (
  lead_id, sequence_id, step_id,
  direction, subject, body_text,
  gmail_thread_id, gmail_message_id,
  intent, sentiment, intent_confidence,
  key_signals, reply_summary,
  sent_at, created_at
) VALUES (
  $1, $2, $3,
  'inbound', $4, $5,
  $6, $7,
  $8, $9, $10,
  $11::jsonb, $12,
  $13::timestamptz, NOW()
)
RETURNING id AS conversation_id;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO conversations (
  lead_id, sequence_id, step_id,
  direction, subject, body_text,
  gmail_thread_id, intent,
  sent_at, created_at
) VALUES (
  $1, $2, $3,
  'outbound', $4, $5,
  $6, 'reply_sent',
  NOW(), NOW()
);

INSERT INTO sequence_steps (
  sequence_id, step_number, step_type,
  subject, body_text, preview_text,
  scheduled_at, status,
  strategy_used, created_at
) SELECT
  s.id,
  COALESCE(MAX(ss.step_number), 0) + 1,
  'follow_up',
  'Following up — ' || l.company,
  'Scheduled follow-up after auto-reply or neutral response.',
  'Following up soon',
  NOW() + ($2 || ' days')::INTERVAL,
  'scheduled',
  $3,
  NOW()
FROM sequences s
JOIN leads l ON l.id = s.lead_id
LEFT JOIN sequence_steps ss ON ss.sequence_id = s.id
WHERE s.id = $1
GROUP BY s.id, l.company
RETURNING id AS step_id;

UPDATE sequences  SET status = 'paused',       updated_at = NOW() WHERE id  = $1;
UPDATE leads      SET status = 'not_interested', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id  = $2;
